text: Spoke to Kieran after work. His dad's hip replacement is booked for 14 May at the Royal, and he's already dreading the drive up and down every day.
Mehmet's band are playing the Fleece on Friday at 9pm. He's on bass now, apparently, not guitar.
Called Bethany. Her nan passed away on Sunday morning. The funeral is on the 3rd of June at 11am in Truro. Remind me to send flowers to her mum's house before then.
Stefan was made redundant yesterday. He seemed oddly calm about it, said he'd seen it coming since March.
Emeka is running the Bristol half on 21/09. He's been training with his brother Hamza most mornings. Need to text him good luck the night before.
Francesca's knee surgery went well. She's home now but on crutches for at least six weeks, and very bored.
Picked up the prescription and booked my own dentist check-up for Thursday at 4:15.
Lunch with Mohammed. His daughter has her grade 5 piano recital on 12 July at 2pm, and he wants me to come along. He's more nervous than she is.
Samir and Isla have split up. It sounds mutual, but Isla is staying with her sister for a while. Don't forget to check in with Isla next week.
Thabo's mum is in hospital with pneumonia. He's flying back to Johannesburg tomorrow evening.
Caitlin has an audition for the Cheltenham youth orchestra on Saturday morning. She's been practising the Elgar for weeks and is really anxious about it.
Jen's cat Pickle had a lump removed on Tuesday. All clear, thankfully, and Pickle is back to stealing ham.
Imogen says the play is the 18th, 19th and 20th of October, all at 7:30. She's playing the stepmother. Must book tickets for the Saturday.
Ahmed was let go from the bank on Friday afternoon along with half his team. He's trying to stay positive but he's clearly rattled. I should take him for a pint at some point this week.
Bumped into Ethan and his wife at the shops. Their son Alfie starts physio for his ankle on Monday at 8am.
Nikolai lost his grandfather last month. He's been quiet since. He mentioned his grandfather taught him chess, so maybe that's why he's stopped playing online.

Ryan's five-a-side team made the league final. It's next Wednesday at 6:30 at Goals. He's playing in goal because their keeper Malik broke his wrist last month and is still in a cast until 1 November. Ryan says he's useless in goal and fully expects to lose. Remind me to ask Ryan how it went on Thursday morning.
Leah had her gallbladder out this morning. Her partner Kwame says she's groggy but fine. Remind me to call her on Friday afternoon to see how she's feeling.
Kwame is doing the Three Peaks challenge on 6 August for the hospice that looked after his dad. I need to sponsor him.
Eduardo got dumped over text. Over text! Luis and I are taking him out on Saturday night to cheer him up.
Gintaras plays in a brass band and they're competing at the regional championships in Blackpool on 15/11. He plays the euphonium, which I had to look up.
Alejandro's mother's funeral is on Thursday the 9th at 2pm. His sister Manon is flying in from Seville the day before. I should ask whether they need anyone to help with the wake.
Ava has a scan at the Princess Anne on Monday morning. She didn't say what for and I didn't push.
Hamza is obsessed with Formula 1 at the moment. He keeps saying he'd love a day at Silverstone, which would make a brilliant birthday present.

Had a long call with Malik. His uncle had a stroke on Saturday and is still in intensive care. Malik's driving to Leicester every evening after work and running on empty. His boss has been decent about it, which helps. Remind me to text him tomorrow, and maybe drop some food round at the weekend so he doesn't have to cook.
Karan's choir concert has been cancelled because the church roof is leaking. He's gutted, they'd rehearsed for months.
Vikram is having his wisdom teeth out on 2nd December. He's asked if I can drive him home afterwards, which is fine. I'm picking him up at 1pm.

Elijah won his chess tournament in Reading! First place in the under-18 section, and he beat the top seed in the final round after nearly four hours. His mum was over the moon and his little brother Karan made him a medal out of foil. He's now hoping to get picked for the county team. I should send him a congratulations card.
Manon mentioned she's vegetarian and allergic to cashews. Worth remembering for the dinner.

Coffee with Isla. She's still struggling after the breakup with Samir, especially now he's moved his stuff out. She's started running in the evenings, which seems to help. She's entered a 10k on 28 September. Ask her how her training is going next time.
Note to self: renew the car insurance before 30/06 and get the boiler serviced.
Stefan's leaving drinks were meant to be on Friday but he's called them off. He says he isn't in the mood after the redundancy.
Kieran's dad's operation was yesterday. Need to ask Kieran how it went.
Mehmet's wife Leah is having her ankle pinned on the 23rd at 8am. Their twins will be with her parents for the week.
Spoke to Bethany again. The funeral went as well as these things can. Her mum is not coping well and Bethany is staying down there until the end of the month.
Emeka finished the half in 1:52! A personal best by four minutes. I should send him a congratulations message.
Francesca loves Agatha Christie and she's working her way through them all while she recovers. Could get her a nice box set.

Mohammed's daughter was brilliant at the recital on Saturday. She played the Chopin without a single slip and got a standing ovation from the grandparents' row. Mohammed cried, obviously, and filmed the whole thing at a strange angle. Her teacher thinks she should go for grade 6 in the spring. I should send him a card for her.

Thabo texted from Johannesburg. His mum is out of hospital but needs a few weeks of rest at home, and his sister can't take more time off, so he's staying until 4 March at least. He's working remotely but the time difference isn't the issue, it's the internet. He sounded tired. Need to call him on Sunday at about 6pm our time.
Big week. Tuesday at 10am is my appraisal, Wednesday evening I've got the plumber, and Saturday is the Hamilton matinee with Mum.
Caitlin got into the orchestra! Rehearsals start on the 7th at half 6.
Ahmed has two interviews lined up already, one on Monday at 11 and one on Thursday afternoon. Remind me to wish him luck on Sunday evening.
Ethan is training for an Ironman in Copenhagen next August. He's vegan and swims at 6am most days, which sounds miserable.

Imogen said opening night was a disaster. A whole wall of the set fell over in the second act, the lead forgot his lines, and the fire alarm went off during the interval. Somehow the reviews have been kind, and the Saturday show has sold out. She's exhausted and says she needs a week of sleep after closing night on the 20th.
Ryan's mum is having a cataract operation on 17 April at 9:30. Ryan can't get the day off, so his brother Ethan is taking her.
Leah and Kwame are moving to Leeds in the spring. Kwame's got a job at the university there.

Jen's brother Stefan, the one in Glasgow, was made redundant this morning. Jen is furious on his behalf because he'd only been there eighteen months and they'd just relocated him. He's got a mortgage and a baby due in January, so it's terrible timing. Don't forget to ask Jen how Stefan is doing at the weekend.

Gintaras's band came second at the championships in Blackpool, which is the best they've ever done. He said the test piece was brutal and two of the cornets were off with flu, so they had to borrow players from another band the night before. He's thrilled and already talking about the nationals next year, which would be in Cheltenham in September.
Hamza's dad passed away in the early hours of Tuesday. The janazah is tomorrow at 1pm at the mosque on Green Lane. I must go. I should also ask Malik whether people are collecting for the family.
Eduardo's doing much better. He's joined a climbing gym with Luis and seems to have mostly stopped checking her Instagram.
Alejandro wanted to say thank you for coming to the funeral. He's going back to work on Monday.
Elijah's next tournament is in Birmingham on 3rd of August. His mum is driving him.

Manon is running the London marathon next April for a cancer charity. She lost her aunt last year. She said she's terrified about the training, and that her knees are already complaining. Remind me to sponsor her on payday, the 25th.
Vikram's back home and complaining that he can only eat soup. Ice cream's allowed, though.
Dinner with Nikolai and his girlfriend Ava. Ava has an appendix scar from surgery in the summer and showed everyone, unprompted. Nikolai seems happier than last month.
Karan says the choir has rescheduled the concert for 14 December at 7pm in the town hall instead.
Dentist moved my appointment to the 10th at 8:40. Need to tell work I'll be in late.

Ava told me the scan was fine. She'd been worried it was something serious and hadn't slept properly in a fortnight, but it's just a cyst and they'll keep an eye on it. She has a follow-up appointment on 14/01 at 10:20, and her husband is going with her this time. She's planning a weekend in the Lakes to celebrate.

Samir's grandmother died on 2 November. He's flying to Karachi on Friday morning for the funeral and will be away for two weeks. His manager has been really understanding. I should message him on Thursday night before he goes, and remind me to check on his flat while he's away. He asked me to water the plants.
Mrs Evans next door had her hip done on Monday. Her son Kieran is visiting each evening. Must take her round some of the lemon drizzle.
